title: Hardware Test Evidence Manifest
description: Top-level manifest for a hardware evidence bundle. Each release/evidence/host-bench/<date>-<hostname>/ directory contains exactly one hwtest-manifest.json that ties together the plan, host, baseline result, optid result, and verdict.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Frozen at 1; future versions must bump and the validator must handle old versions or refuse.

manifest_kind.description: Discriminator field so the validator can confirm it's reading the right file type.

source_version.description: The Rush Linux project version this evidence certifies (e.g. '0.7.0-beta.1'). Must match the VERSION file.

source_commit.description: The 40-character git commit SHA this evidence was produced against.

hardware_slot.description: Which reference-hardware slot this bundle certifies. 'laptop' is required for battery criteria.

bundle_created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the bundle was assembled.

plan_path.description: Relative path to the hwtest-plan.json file.

host_path.description: Relative path to the hwtest-host.json file.

baseline_result_path.description: Relative path to the baseline hwtest-result.json file.

optid_result_path.description: Relative path to the optid hwtest-result.json file.

verdict_path.description: Relative path to the VERDICT.md file. The verdict is ADVISORY ONLY — AI summaries do not count as evidence.

events_path.description: Relative path to the events.jsonl tamper-evident event chain.

privacy_report_path.description: Relative path to the privacy-report.json file.

operator.description: Optional: name or handle of the operator who produced the evidence.
